answer: To blunt sybil swarms, each new identity should lock a decaying work-bond that unlocks only after three independently clocked attestations from miners whose last-epoch co-signature graphs share no ancestors with the applicant or each other. Key-reuse farms collapse into one neighborhood: a mesa that looks broad from the ocean but, from the summit, is a single ridgeline of cloned trailheads. Overlapping clusters lose the bond and grading seats.
